counting.note: Figure9 has6 axes;Figure11 has2; other figures one each. Flowcharts are figure objects, not numbered algorithms. Two author biographies excluded from body.

taxonomy: VMD frequency regrouping + three Pyraformer branches + Adan optimization

module_roles.VMD: reduce modal mixing / expose frequency bands
module_roles.grouping: zero-crossing rate plus PCC separates low/mid/high
module_roles.Pyraformer: CSCM coarse-scale tree and PAM intra/inter-scale attention

framework.inputs: Load and decomposed groups; each branch receives original load plus group representation
framework.output: Load prediction; branch fusion operator not mathematically specified
framework.physical_theory: No power flow, scheduling or operational optimization
framework.new_theory: No new theorem; standard decomposition equations dominate mathematical inventory

Missing 1/n; expression is a sum of percentage errors rather than their mean; zero-load rule not stated

statistics.units: Temporally dependent load samples; no independent replication unit defined
statistics.data: Elia Jan1 2018-Dec31 2019,15min,70080 points; total consistent with730*96
statistics.split: Training and test named but sizes/dates, horizon/input length/rolling origin, scaler fitting and VMD boundary absent
statistics.leakage_assessment: Full-range component plots motivate a prospective-VMD audit; they do not alone prove evaluation leakage
statistics.generalization: Single grid and period; no external system, season-level results or operational dispatch validation
statistics.complexity: Inherited Pyraformer low-complexity statement; no own FLOPs/memory or measured scalability comparison
